change_summary: Added an audit-only runner that replays the accepted A+B stack, isolates trend_late_rollover losers, and records late exit-failure subfamilies using in-trade path state plus winner collateral.
hypothesis: The accepted stack's trend_late_rollover losses cluster into reproducible late exit-failure subfamilies that can be counted without changing strategy logic.
notes: Artifact: data/exp_20260426_006_trend_late_rollover_audit.json. Cross-window result: 5 late-rollover losses for trend_long, 0 repeated fine-grain subfamilies, and all late-rollover exits occurred in risk_on buckets. The largest coarse concentration was in old_thin low-peak late losers: peak<5% accounted for $1701.04 (59.7%) and peak 5-15% plus giveback>=15% added $1114.79. However coarse buckets still carry meaningful winner collateral: Financials late trades include 3 winners worth $7104.92, Technology late trades include 3 winners worth $4700.75, and Communication Services includes a winner worth $2296.79. This means trend_late_rollover is currently a sparse tail-loss family, not a reusable zero-collateral rule template. LLM entry archive coverage stayed 0/5 and news archive was missing on 5/5 losses. One loss row (TRIP) carried sector=Unknown, which should be treated as a measurement-quality note for future attribution work, not a new strategy rule.
